groups.note: The corner of Harr's square where a player first meets a resident: two benches, a lantern beside them and a signboard. Anchored on the plaza the server resolves from world generation (Plaza[0]), never on a coordinate.
The market end of the square: crates, a barrel, a bucket and a handcart, the sort of thing a trader leaves out. Eight blocks off the plaza's centre so it does not sit on the meeting corner.
Kael's end of Harr: the workshop's yard, with the smith's and the carpenter's own tools set out. Anchored on Workshop[0].

A furnished interior in Harr: the surveyor's hut on the farm field where the Quiet Survey begins. A sealed room (walls, a doorway, four windows and a roof) with a bed, a table, chairs, a bookshelf, a hearth, a cooking pot, a workbench and two lanterns inside; a crate, a barrel and a lanternpost outside the door. Positions are relative to the ground measured at the hut's own centre, so the whole thing moves with the terrain.

note: Harr's dressed world, written by the world stream: three groups of props on the square and in the workshop's yard, and one furnished interior - a surveyor's hut on the farm field where the Quiet Survey begins. Every anchor is a plot of the site (Plaza, Workshop, FarmField) that the Veloren server resolves from world generation, and every name here is one of the game's own block kinds and sprites; `nemo-world-check` and NemoWorld's own validator both have to accept the file before a server will apply it. The atmosphere block follows NemoWorld's published clock (120-minute cycle, four phases): the server pins the absolute time of day to it, so the sun never jumps and an in-game day lasts 120 real minutes rather than the settings' day_length. The four hours are not free: they are the boundaries of Veloren's own day periods (Night before 06:00, Morning to 11:00, Noon to 16:00, Evening to 19:00, Night after - common/src/time.rs), so each of NemoWorld's phases falls entirely inside the one Veloren period the bridge names the same way. That is what makes a resident's schedule follow NemoWorld's phase exactly. `weather` is false on purpose: this server sets the time, not the weather.
